title: The Moon Moves Into the Cabin
skyStory: At fifteen percent, the crescent bounds into Aries, Joel's own sign, and kicks the cabin door open like it owns the place. It tosses its coat on a chair and asks what is for dinner. Mars, ruler of Aries, is thrilled to have company. The two of them start planning a project before the woodstove has even caught. The cabin chimney puffs happily.

reading: The moon has come to visit your sign, and you will feel it the moment you wake up. Energy. Ideas. An urge to rearrange the furniture before breakfast. The Tiger is up and pacing, tail flicking. Point it at something useful.

The [[Knight of Wands]] rides alongside today, but it carries a single torch, not a bundle. Pick the one project that makes you grin and give it two good hours. Two. Then stop while it is still exciting. The trick to starting fires is knowing when to let them burn on their own.
joel.mission: Give one project two focused hours, then walk away while you still want more.
joel.omen: A red car, a red hat, or a red mailbox catching sunlight. It means Mars is cheering you on.
joel.stoneWhy: an anchor for a racing Tiger

reading: With the moon in Joel's sign, you might catch a little of his spark today. You will want to start something. You might even start it. Your steady Capricorn hands paired with borrowed Aries fire are a dangerous combination, in the best possible way.

Around 11 am, an idea arrives that seems too bold for a Wednesday in February. It is not. Write it down. Saturn and Mars are clinking mugs somewhere up there, impressed with themselves for once. Mountain meets fire. Let the spark catch on something you care about.
nancy.mission: Say yes to one small adventure today that you would usually save for later.
nancy.omen: A flame flickering in a window or on a candle. It means Joel is sending a spark your way.

together.text: Joel, switch the onyx to your right wrist for one hour today and send a spark down the line. Nancy, tap the ruby twice when you feel it. Neither of you will be able to prove it worked. Both of you will know.

game.intro: The moon moves into Aries and settles into the cabin. Chimney smoking. Show us something that belongs there.
game.prompt: Something that would look right at home in a cabin in the woods.
